note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (checked 20 Nov 2026). Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide. A guide marked confirmed draws on a published guide or follows directly from the official description; one marked unconfirmed says so plainly, because no published guide had a verified method when we checked.

EXO.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official names, descriptions, grades)

PSN.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets)

PSQ.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

KG.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, and there is no separate task behind it. Because one of those 54 is A Long Road for 100% completion, the platinum is really a full-completion run — PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours and Push Square 300 or more. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and the platinum will pop on its own when the last checklist item is done.
steps: Play the story to the end
Clear the strangers, activities, crime and collectible stages
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road
The platinum unlocks with the final trophy

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission, and this pops at the end of it — it is the first trophy most players will earn and it cannot be missed. Just play the story from the start; there is nothing to prepare and no choice to get wrong.
steps: Start a new game
Play through Gone Fishing to its end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this pops when the chapter's final mission ends. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions and it arrives on its own.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and this pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable — it is a milestone for playing the story, not a challenge to prepare for.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Unmissable, like the other chapter trophies — just keep working through the main missions.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this pops when the chapter's final mission ends. It marks the back stretch of the story — after it, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and this gold trophy pops at the end of the story. After it, free roam continues and the 100% completion checklist opens (Push Square), so this is the doorway to the whole cleanup phase — nothing is locked away once the credits roll.
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named-mission trophy, so it pops the moment that mission ends — unmissable, and a sign you are on the story path rather than wandering Leonida.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears
Complete Breakfast Run

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big set-piece heists of the campaign, and the trophy pops when the mission ends — no preparation needed, just play the story to it.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears
Complete The Cartel Heist

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A named-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends — unmissable, and one of the story beats you will reach naturally on the way through the chapters.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears
Complete Child's Play

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops the moment the mission ends — a story milestone, unmissable, and worth enjoying rather than rushing, since the mission itself is the point.
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears
Complete Headliners

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission ends — unmissable, and a good reason to get comfortable with the airport, since the Catch Me If You Can trophy sends you back there later.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears
Complete VCIA Takedown

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies — it pops when the mission ends, unmissable, and it usually lands late in the campaign, close to the finale.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Complete Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist opens after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion, per Push Square) and covers story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries — but not literally everything: only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, and 70 of the 80 challenges. Treat the in-game checklist as the authority, not your trophy count. This is the last trophy for most players and the reason the platinum takes 200 hours or more.
steps: Finish the story to open the 100% checklist
Work the checklist category by category
Watch the in-game percentage, not your trophy count

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are Stunt Jumps (130 in the game), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25) — 397 in total, so you need just over half (Push Square). Mix types freely; find them on the map via Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts. Start early and grab them as you travel — they are a long grind if left to the end.
steps: Open Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see stunt locations
Complete any mix of jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps
Track the count at Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types in the game, and this pops the first time you have tried each one once — you do not need to win or finish anything, just take part. The fastest route is to sample them during the story: a race, a fishing trip, a shooting range session, a drone race, an arcade game, a bowling game and a stunt will cover most of them. Track what you have tried under Touch Pad, Progress, Activities.
steps: Try a race, a fishing spot, a shooting range and a drone race
Try an arcade game, a bowling alley and a stunt
The trophy pops when the ninth type is sampled

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them across two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (Push Square). Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some are locked until you meet their conditions, shown on the map. Find ranges via Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges and track progress there. Take it slowly: gold medals need accuracy and speed, and the harder tiers are the real test of this trophy.
steps: Visit Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero)
Work through each challenge's tiers to gold
Check locked challenges' conditions on the map

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 of them, some with entry fees (Push Square). Find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. You only need first place once per location; learn each course's corners rather than brute-forcing speed.
steps: Open Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones
Win one race at each of the 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replaying the same race does not count — each of the 20 must be a different race (Push Square). Find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Racing; most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades. Work through the list and tick them off as you go.
steps: Open Touch Pad, Activities, Racing for the race list
Win 20 different races, using hired cars where offered

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg (Push Square): fish in the marked area from a boat with a fishing rod until you land one big enough — hijack a boat in the area if you do not own one. The weight is the whole challenge; keep fishing in the marked spot until a 2kg-plus Parrotfish bites.
steps: Take Cal's request to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg
Get a boat with a fishing rod and fish the marked area
Land a Parrotfish over 2kg

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine — arcades are scattered around Vice City — start any game and play it to its end. You do not need a high score, just a finished game.
steps: Find an arcade machine
Play any game through to its end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of missions; keep answering his calls and playing his jobs until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the final one, Puff Puff Pass (KeenGamer). Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so if Andy goes quiet, play more story first.
steps: Play Andy's missions as they appear
Finish the strand's final mission, Puff Puff Pass

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the mission Maritime Disputes (Push Square). Play Kenton's strand through to the end; as with the other stranger characters, later missions unlock as the story advances.
steps: Play Kenton's missions as they appear
Finish Maritime Disputes

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the mission Hometown Heroes (Push Square). Same pattern as the other stranger strands: keep playing Billy's jobs until the strand closes.
steps: Play Billy's missions as they appear
Finish Hometown Heroes

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more strands than you need (PowerPyx counts 14, via FullSweep), so pick the eight you enjoy and finish each strand to its final mission. Stranger missions appear on the map as question marks and as phone calls; the five named characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight, so their trophies and this one progress together.
steps: Find stranger missions on the map and by phone
Finish 8 full strands, including the five named characters

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand involves his wish-list vehicles — Push Square links a list of the vehicle locations — so expect to hunt down specific cars as well as play his missions. Finish the strand's last mission to pop it.
steps: Play Randy's missions and collect his wish-list vehicles
Finish the strand's final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is tied to the Kitty Litter Lab locations (Push Square) — find the labs as you work through his missions, then finish the strand's final mission.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions and visit the Kitty Litter Labs
Finish the strand's final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots (Push Square, GTABase). This is the one trophy other guides flag as possibly missable: one spot is at Jason's house and can only be used early in the story, in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, via FullSweep), so meditate there the first chance you get. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find spots at Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house at the first opportunity
Meditate at all 18 spots, waiting for the zen animation each time
Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is about hunting: unique animals are one-off hunts, not regular wildlife, so follow Bret's missions and the hunt prompts they give. Finish the hunt he sets you and the trophy pops.
steps: Play Bret's strand as it appears
Complete the unique-animal hunt he sets

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game (Push Square), and you only need three complete sets for this trophy — but if you are going for 100%, you will need 15, so treat this as an early milestone on the way there. Track cards at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards; collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is an app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it) that scans landmarks for extra information (Push Square). Scannable spots include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — you need 100 successful scans in total. Scan as you explore and track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up)
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags
Reach 100 scans

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's in-world feats (Push Square): 80 in total, 50 for this trophy and 70 for 100% completion. Browse them at Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges and pick off the easy ones first — many complete naturally during the story and the other grinds.
steps: Open Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges
Complete any 50 challenges

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build your wanted level to 4 stars while your partner (Jason or Lucia) is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — the trophy pops when you escape, not when the stars appear. Use the map's wanted radius: get outside the search area and keep moving until it fades.
steps: Have your partner with you
Raise a 4-star wanted level
Escape the search area until the wanted level clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob a shop with your partner alongside, then move straight to the next shop and the next — the chain breaks if your wanted level drops between robberies, so keep the heat on and do not stop to fight the police. Pick three shops close together and plan the route first.
steps: Bring your partner
Rob a shop, then immediately rob two more
Keep your wanted level alive through all three

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it (Push Square), and 100 different vehicles should come naturally during the story. Track the list at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles; if you are short at the end, drive through car parks and dealership rows trying new models.
steps: Get in or scan vehicles as you play
Reach 100 different vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode: trigger it in a firefight with several enemies in view and drop five before it ends. Pick a busy fight with grouped enemies — a gang shootout or a police chase — and save it for a moment when five targets are close together.
steps: Enter a firefight with several enemies close together
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is Vice City International Airport: the plain reading is to get to the airport and leave by an unscheduled route — steal a plane and take off without following the normal departure flow. No published guide had pinned down a verified method as of 20 Nov 2026, so treat this as our reading of the official description and check the linked sources for an update before grinding it.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport
Take a plane and depart without a scheduled flight

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhino is GTA's tank: the plain reading is to get into one and survive the heat it brings. Rhinos appear at military areas and at high wanted levels, so expect a fight to get one — and no published guide had pinned down a verified method as of 20 Nov 2026, so check the linked sources for an update.
steps: Find a Rhino tank
Drive it and survive the attention it draws

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm — and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again; the trophy needs a fully undetected robbery.
steps: Pick a jewelry store
Rob it without being detected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies: plan the getaway before you go in, and count only the ones where you escape afterwards. Five successful vault jobs, each ending with a clean escape, earn the silver.
steps: Rob a bank vault
Escape cleanly
Repeat for 5 vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads: hit one, grab the cash and get away before the police box you in. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Rob it and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The trophy is about coverage: visit every region of the state — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside — until the map is filled in. Drive the highways and back roads; the in-game map shows what you have and have not seen.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida
Fill in the map until nothing is left unexplored

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; hit one operation for each gang. Gang territory is marked on the map, and operations are the gang-run businesses and fronts you can raid.
steps: Find each gang's illegal operations
Rob one operation for every gang

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or beach spot with a view, and order a cocktail — the trophy is a quiet moment, not a mission. Any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach should do.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail with a view

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The plain reading is a nod to the classic GTA showroom smash: drive a car through a dealership showroom's glass and out the other side. The method is not pinned down in any published guide yet, so treat this as our reading of the official description and check the linked sources for an update.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom
Drive through it and out the front

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — follow through on the throw, as the description says. A completed game at that alley is all it takes.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Bowl a game

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague and no published guide had a verified method as of 20 Nov 2026 — the plain reading is a partner activity done to a high standard, most likely tied to doing something with your partner that draws a crowd. Check the sources linked here for updates before grinding it.
steps: No verified method yet — see the sources for updates

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This reads as a story trophy tied to a decision in the campaign — the description is the game's way of saying a choice you made mattered. Play the story and it should pop when the choice's consequences land; there is no separate task and nothing to prepare. No published guide had confirmed the exact moment as of 20 Nov 2026.
steps: Play through the story
The trophy pops when a story choice resolves

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No published guide had a verified method as of 20 Nov 2026 — the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. The honest advice: if a challenge or attempt fails once, try it again immediately rather than moving on.
steps: No verified method yet — see the sources for updates

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No published guide had a verified method as of 20 Nov 2026 — the name and description point at an easter egg or strange encounter somewhere in Leonida (the classic GTA UFO-style secret). Keep an eye on the linked guides for a confirmed location; do not grind for it blind.
steps: No verified method yet — see the sources for updates

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. This is a bowling-alley stunt with a weapon: perform a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — and knock the pins (or bowlers) over. The exact spot is not confirmed in a published guide yet; the bowling alley from Let's Go Bowling is the obvious place to try it.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Perform a melee drive-by at the bowling alley

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies; launder them through your contacts a little at a time until the total hits $250,000. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score rather than letting bills pile up.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts and it accumulates over the whole game (Push Square) — clothes, weapons, food, car upgrades, all of it. Find shops on the map via Touch Pad, Style. You will likely hit this naturally while buying the garages and gear for other trophies.
steps: Spend money at any shops
Reach $100,000 total spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, $160,000 in total (Push Square): Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Buy them from the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up). Each garage adds one parking spot, which also helps On the Spot.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000 total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle to a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop and register it there (Push Square) — registered vehicles can then be delivered to you by Scooter Bros for a small fee. Register 10 different vehicles; buying the garages from Little Boxes gives you the parking spots to hold them.
steps: Drive a vehicle to a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop
Register it to Scooter Bros
Repeat for 10 different vehicles
